command.scope: Exact /usr/bin/time -l accounting over runner and awaited children plus proof overhead. Platform memory counters retained as reported, without attribution to any particular helper child.

intervalRelations: language-setup-and-start combines provisioning and the Public start. whole-lane excludes bootstrap and includes fresh reads/evidence work; whole-command additionally includes bootstrap/preflight/footprints. Fresh read intervals include CLI process startup and close/reopen work. No unobserved internal split is inferred.
footprintScope: Only newly granted roots. Logical file sizes, allocated file st_blocks times 512 and raw du -sk are retained-cut observations, not allocation peaks; copy-on-write/shared blocks may overlap. npm cache/log activity outside these roots is not inventoried.
unobserved: RuntimeHistorySelection body/selector/suffix/cause counters not exposed by selected caller
child CPU and peak memory for helper-internal subprocesses
native-provider token cost unless reported by retained transcript
helper-internal read/hash/encode/write work and physical cleanup counters not exposed by the selected caller
comparison: Prepared for comparison only to an equivalent candidate P3 with the same repaired support, workload, runner and toolchain. Original failed P3 setup remains separate failure evidence; no speedup claim.
